lead.title: Anthropic ships Claude Sonnet 5.5: faster and cheaper mid-tier model
lead.summary: Anthropic released Claude Sonnet 5.5, the second model in the Claude 5.5 family, described as a clear upgrade over Sonnet 5 that runs more than 30% faster and costs up to 30% less for most workloads. The rest of the day's news skews toward infrastructure: AMD's $8.2B acquisition of World Labs and a $150B NVIDIA buyback authorization headline the ledger.

top_stories.title: NVIDIA board authorizes additional $150B buyback, largest in US history
top_stories.summary: Jensen Huang said the board authorized an extra $150B in buybacks with $235B total remaining, topping Apple's $110B record, to be executed through FY28 on AI cash flow.

top_stories.title: Xing4.0-29B-A4B: 29B MoE with 4B activated and native 256K context
top_stories.summary: China Telecom AI's next-gen Xing-series model (successor to TeleChat3) totals 29B parameters with 4B active per token, natively supports 256K context (extensible to 512K), and runs on Transformers, vLLM, SGLang and KTransformers.

top_stories.title: Holo4 arrives to power generalist computer-use agents
top_stories.summary: Hugging Face's H Company announced Holo4, a model aimed at powering generalist computer-use agents.

top_stories.title: Mistral opens a Munich hub for Physics AI and Industrial AI
top_stories.summary: Mistral announced a new Munich hub partnering with German industry for Physics AI and Industrial AI research.

items.title: PEARL: adaptive prefill-decode execution with elasticity for agentic RL
items.summary: Tackles the cost of multi-turn rollouts in agentic RL by combining asynchronous execution with elastic GPU resources so training GPUs idle less between updates.

items.title: CacheRepair: learning to repair cross-chunk context for KV cache fusion
items.summary: For multi-document RAG, independently precomputed per-chunk KV caches are concatenated, and a learned repair step fixes the gaps that assemblage introduces.

items.title: TempoKV: timely staging of LLM KV caches on memory-semantic flash
items.summary: Addresses the gap between logical KV-cache hits and GPU-ready data in SSD-backed hierarchies with immediate and demand staging for the fast tier.

items.title: TIDE: teacher-student transition for agentic RL with small models
items.summary: Improves on GRPO for multi-turn agents via informative distillation and exploration, easing sparse-reward limits in small models.

items.title: Qwen-Image-2.1: 7B open-weight model unifies image generation and editing
items.summary: Alibaba's Qwen team ships a 7B open-weight model combining image generation, editing, and native RGBA transparency output in one model, with GGUF quantizations available for local ComfyUI pipelines.

items.title: ZDTaichu5.0-9B: multimodal model for spatial reasoning and tool use
items.summary: A 9B model pairing a Qwen3.5-9B backbone with a C-RADIOv4-H vision encoder covers text, images and video at any resolution for agents and embodied-AI research.

items.title: TeleOCR: compact Apache-2.0 document-parsing VLM
items.summary: An image-text-to-text model for both digital and camera-captured documents, part of this week's wave of task-specific lightweight models.

items.title: Ollama v0.35.0 adds the System One decision-model API
items.summary: The new /signal endpoint serves structured decision models that return choices, probabilities and scores instead of free text for routing, classification and triage, shipped alongside the Nimble and Tev1 decision models.

items.title: llama.cpp b11242/b11243: multimodal embeddings and oneAPI 2026.1 CI
items.summary: b11242 adds typed vision/audio/video inputs to the /v1/embeddings endpoint and fixes a GCC 15 stringop-overflow in mtmd; b11243 migrates CI to Intel's unified oneAPI 2026.1 installer to keep oneDNN support.

items.title: Home Assistant 2026.9.4 patch fixes backup streaming and integration deadlocks
items.summary: The patch fixes receive-backup streaming, a backup-util deadlock, and Tuya fan, Todoist and Matter cover issues; the 2026.9 line also brought the Soniox-based voice engine and domain-prefixed LLM tool names.

items.title: GPT-3 davinci endpoint discontinued; pin model IDs in self-hosted pipelines
items.summary: The r/LocalLLaMA digest notes the davinci endpoint's end with no universal EOL date per model; practitioners advise pinning model IDs and testing failover to local Ollama models.

items.title: Early AMD 'Gorgon Halo' mini-PC GMKtec Evo-X5 Pro packs 192GB RAM for $7,099
items.summary: The agentic mini-PC pairs AMD's Ryzen AI Max+ Pro 495 with 192GB of unified RAM, priced up to $7,099 with a $425 early-bird cut — among the highest-capacity options for big local models.

items.title: AMD acquires Fei-Fei Li's World Labs for $8.2B; Li joins as EVP and chief scientist
items.summary: The $8.2B M&A brings the spatial-intelligence team into AMD to shape future AI infrastructure; Fei-Fei Li joins as executive vice president and chief scientist.

items.title: OpenAI's custom Jalapeno inference ASIC stays internal, rollout left open
items.summary: Hardware VP Richard Ho said the Jalapeno chip is for internal use 'first and foremost,' with the company leaving the door open to a broader rollout later.
